vulnerable_code:
class Api::V1::ApiKeysController < Api::BaseController
  def revoke
    # Directly locating API key by ID without scoping to current_organization
    api_key = ApiKey.find_by(id: params[:id])
    return render_not_found unless api_key

    api_key.update!(revoked_at: Time.current, status: :inactive)
    render json: { status: 'revoked', key_id: api_key.id }, status: :ok
  end
end
diagnosis: The revoke action resolves an ApiKey record by un-scoped ID rather than scoping queries through the caller's organization. An authenticated member from one organization can revoke production API credentials belonging to any other organization, causing severe denial of service.

POST /api/v1/api_keys/key_89923/revoke HTTP/1.1

corrected_code:
class Api::V1::ApiKeysController < Api::BaseController
  def revoke
    api_key = current_organization.api_keys.find(params[:id])
    api_key.update!(revoked_at: Time.current, status: :inactive)
    render json: { status: 'revoked', key_id: api_key.id }, status: :ok
  end
end
